note: Add the private unified PYTHIA plugin (cloud + CLI + Desktop, one install) through this Devin UI dialog. Values below are exactly what the form is filled with.

ui.description: Devin reads the plugin from the private repository each time it runs, so approved main-branch changes take effect without re-adding it

Repository.hint: Do not include plaintext secrets. Use plugin secret references instead

Subdirectory.hint: The plugin root inside the repository
Subdirectory.warning: Use the folder containing .devin-plugin/plugin.json, not this handoff document.

runtime_provenance.rule: Every session records the exact plugin_source_sha. Following main does not permit an unversioned completion claim.
